summary.goal: Permanent bottom status bar providing ambient awareness of agent activity, plan context, and session stats across all views.

acceptance_criteria.description: Status bar is fixed to bottom of viewport, always visible
Context section shows current plan name, version, and status badge
Agent avatars section renders slot for each active agent
Stats section shows pending questions count and resolved decisions count
Status bar can be collapsed to minimal height
Clicking pending questions count opens Messages view filtered to pending

steps.title: Create StatusBar component shell
steps.description: Create StatusBar.tsx with fixed bottom positioning, 4-section layout (context, agents, stats, meta), expanded/collapsed states
acceptance: Component renders at bottom of viewport
4 sections visible with correct flex layout

custom_components: AgentAvatar - 32x32 circle with emoji/icon, state indicator (dot/ring), tooltip on hover

steps.title: Implement context section
steps.description: Plan icon, name (truncated), version badge, status badge. Handle 'no active plan' state.
acceptance: Shows current plan name and version
Shows 'No active plan' when none selected

steps.title: Implement agents section
steps.description: Render AgentAvatar components for each active agent, centered layout
acceptance: Avatars render for all active agents
Empty state when no agents active

steps.title: Implement stats section
steps.description: Pending questions count (clickable), resolved decisions count

steps.title: Implement meta section
steps.description: Session timer (mm:ss format), collapse/expand toggle button
acceptance: Collapsed state shows only avatars + pending badge

steps.title: Integrate StatusBar into Layout
steps.description: Add StatusBar to Layout.tsx, ensure proper z-index and spacing with main content
acceptance: Main content has bottom padding to not overlap

steps.title: Create useAgentOrchestration hook
steps.description: Hook to manage agent orchestration state - active agents, questions, decisions. Connects to relay for real-time updates.
acceptance: Hook provides agents list with states

views.name: Status Bar (Expanded)
views.layout: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-12 bg-bg-secondary border-t border-border-subtle z-50 flex items-center px-4 gap-6

elements.class: flex items-center gap-1 text-sm hover:text-accent-cyan cursor-pointer

views.name: Status Bar (Collapsed)
views.layout: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-6 bg-bg-secondary border-t border-border-subtle z-50 flex items-center justify-center gap-2

no-active-plan.context: shows 'No active plan' with muted text

pending-questions-highlight.effect: ❓ badge uses text-error color, pulses if count > 5

responsive.mobile: Hide context section, show only agents + stats in collapsed mode
